target_customer: Vegetable farms that would buy or lease modular automation machines
problem: Sustainable vegetable farming is labor heavy. Modular Science aimed to automate farm work with modular electric machines.
business_model: Agricultural robotics hardware, details not stated in sources

founders.name: Peter Sand
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him with no background. Seedtable names a different founder, which is unconfirmed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Field robots need perception, plant geometry estimation and reliable hardware outdoors. The NSF grant title Estimation of Detailed Plant Geometry for Robotic Farm Work shows the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: No patents or customers were found in sources, so any moat rested on unproven engineering.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Deere bought Blue River Technology in 2017 for weeding robots, but no source shows incumbents acting against Modular Science.

market_need_then: Farm labor shortages and interest in agricultural robots existed in 2017, but no source gives demand evidence specific to this company.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with several unrelated Modular companies, and no press or community about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Modular Science took the YC seed in 2017 and received an NSF SBIR Phase I grant of about 254 thousand dollars in 2021, which shows the company was still working on farm robotics four years after the batch. No later round, exit or shutdown report was found, so the cause of the inactive YC status is not public.
notes: The company site did not resolve from this environment (DNS failure), so it was not read. Competitors: no source dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty. The seed rests on Bouncewatch and CB Insights only, and may be the standard YC deal. The NSF grant amount comes from one grant listing and Bouncewatch. CB Insights lists the company as alive with about 370K raised, and Seedtable reports 2.5M raised, which conflicts and is unverified. YC lists it inactive, which conflicts with the 2021 grant.
